items.bullet_summary_preload:
- The **Justice Department** announced Tuesday that it has reached milestones, including charges and convictions, against more than 800 defendants in over 400 scam cases since March[1].
- The push follows **President Trump's** March 6 executive order, and the FBI says its **Operation Blackout** helped dismantle more than 29 scam compounds abroad[1].
- FBI Director **Kash Patel** said more than 2,200 trafficked workers were freed, though officials didn't say how much money has reached victims[3][4].

items.bullet_summary_preload:
- **The Conference Board** said Tuesday its consumer confidence index rose to 103.3 in November from 91.9, beating the 92.1 consensus forecast[1][3].
- Economist **Fergus McCormick** tied the rally to lower uncertainty after the midterms and a better view of the job market, while AP cited falling gas prices[1][2].
- Inflation expectations remained high at 5.7%, and the **University of Michigan** sentiment index also rose in November, to 51.5[1][8].

items.bullet_summary_preload:
- **Riyadh's** 385-meter **PIF tower** was hit by a projectile Tuesday, witnesses told AFP, and the **Saudi-led coalition** called it a "cowardly terrorist attack."[1][4]
- Saudi state agency **SPA** said a **Houthi** attack Nov. 19 damaged several tower floors, after a Nov. 8 strike on Aramco's nearby building.[5][7]
- The district houses **Saudi Tadawul** and **Goldman Sachs** offices, and repeated strikes challenge Riyadh's pitch of a safe hub for global capital.[1]
